description: This file is a benchmarking script for RNNs and CNNs using PyTorch. It includes functions for timing, printing results, and running benchmarks with various configurations, as well as command-line argument parsing for flexible execution.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Shim class for torch.cuda.Event when running on CPU, providing timing functionality.

methods.name: fit_str
methods.description: Formats a string to a fixed column width, padding or truncating as needed.

methods.name: to_str
methods.description: Converts an item to string, formatting floats with 4 significant digits.

methods.name: print_header
methods.description: Generates a header line for benchmark results based on BenchResult fields.

methods.name: trainbench
methods.description: Runs a training benchmark for an RNN model, measuring forward and backward pass times.

methods.name: print_json_oss_format
methods.description: Outputs benchmark results in OSS JSON format.

methods.name: print_json_pep_format
methods.description: Outputs benchmark results in AI-PEP JSON format.

methods.name: bench
methods.description: Runs benchmarks for a set of RNN models and prints results.

methods.name: bench_group
methods.description: Runs a group of benchmarks for specified models and prints progress.
